rationale: The agent executed order-changing writes (a return and a modification) without obtaining explicit user confirmation beforehand. It did not provide clear authentication beyond email/user lookups, and there is no evidence it verified that the returned speaker matched the user’s criteria (“more expensive yet not water resistant”), as no product comparisons or attributes were checked. For the laptop change, it unilaterally modified the order to a specific 13-inch item without confirming availability or presenting options per the user’s stated preferences (i5 over i7, silver/black), which the policy requires, and without prior confirmation. The final message did not summarize outcomes or provide correct final information. These issues violate the policy, so the conversation fails the pass bar.
